info.title: AI Network Anomaly Detection & Traceability API
info.description: RESTful API providing network flow telemetry ingestion, machine learning anomaly analysis, incident response tracking, timeline correlation, and cryptographic key rotation audit contracts.

post.summary: Simulate deterministic adaptive security response & key rotation decision (dry-run)
post.description: Evaluate deterministic Issue #27 policy recommendations (NO_ACTION, MONITOR, INVESTIGATE, ISOLATE_RECOMMENDED) and adaptive key rotation readiness in strict dry-run simulation mode only (executed=false). ABSTAINED_OOD flows never receive containment recommendations; OS firewall and real crypto key modifications are disabled.

anomaly_score.description: Unclamped raw model anomaly score or supervised attack probability (matching raw_anomaly_score; never clamped into [0, 1] for unsupervised models)

raw_anomaly_score.title: Raw Anomaly Score
raw_anomaly_score.description: Exact finite raw model anomaly/reconstruction score or supervised attack probability without clamping or heuristic scaling

normalized_anomaly_score.title: Normalized Anomaly Score
normalized_anomaly_score.description: Calibrated UI-friendly [0, 1] anomaly score when a valid Train/Validation calibration contract exists (or attack probability for supervised classifiers); null otherwise

attack_probability.title: Attack Probability
attack_probability.description: Attack class probability emitted by supervised probabilistic models; null for unsupervised or heuristic models

probabilities.title: Probabilities
probabilities.description: Per-class probabilities (e.g. {'Benign': p0, 'Attack': p1}) when emitted by the model

score_direction.title: Score Direction
score_direction.description: Ordering direction of anomaly_score and raw_anomaly_score
